note: Draft authorization manifest per evidence/M1_FINAL/02_protocol/run_policy.md section 3 and 04_experiment_registry/append_only_policy.md. It grants NOTHING until the approval block is filled with the Research Lead's exact approval text and timestamp, the file is committed, and its SHA-256 is recorded in an AUTHORIZATION_RECORDED event. Nothing may be executed from this draft.

workbook_task.title: Run matched QARF/QPAF seed 2
workbook_task.deliverable: Seed-2 checkpoints, predictions, telemetry and independent reviews

purpose: Train the learned QARF comparator (query-level gate) for preregistered seed 20260821 on the same sealed M3.1 inputs, frozen config, sources, budget and evaluator as the accepted seed-1 M3.2 run, changing only training.seed, and retain checkpoints, predictions, metrics, telemetry and provenance for an independent review before the matched seed-2 QPAF run (m5.3-002) may be authorized.
claim_scope: QARF seed-2 development training evidence on train/validation only. No test labels, no selection among seeds, no QPAF-versus-QARF or baseline claim. Seed-averaged evidence belongs to M5.7; TEST-172 to R7.

git.code_base_description: develop after merge of PR #42 (M5.2 cache parity)
git.tracked_state_policy: At run start, git diff --name-only against code_base_commit must list only paths under allowed_diff_from_base, and git status --porcelain must show no modified tracked files.

seed_contract.rule: M5.1 matched_run_rule: only training.seed changes; QARF is reviewed before the matched QPAF; fresh-process reload <= 1e-7 and finite outputs for every checkpoint; every valid seed is retained.
seed_contract.cache_receipt_acceptance: TECHNICAL_PASS; owner/reviewer acceptance of M5.2 still PENDING_USER_REVIEW

seed_reference.rule: sealed_inputs, metric, runtime, hardware and the shared limits equal the seed-1 authorization; the command equals its command with only --config and the output root replaced; the finished run must reproduce the seed-1 data_manifest.json byte for byte and its provenance inputs except the config hash.

sealed_inputs.candidate_definition: M2.8-002 top-document expansion (A003, post hoc), page-level, cap 600, macro candidate recall 1.0, zero uncovered queries

method.name: QARF
method.note: The method is NOT part of the resolved config (the config has no method key); it is selected only by --method. The command below therefore binds it explicitly.
method.seed_purpose: second of the three frozen seeds (seed_policy.md; M5.1 seed_matrix, task M5.3/R3)

config.semantic_parent: results/m3.1/.../inputs/shared_base.toml (M4.3 frozen config 3e58a867...9b58); the bytes differ only in the training.seed digits, and the parsed config equals the M5.2 receipt matrix entry for seed 20260821

frozen_values.selection_metric: ndcg_at_10 (validation only; ties keep the earlier epoch)

config.expected_hash_basis: Computed before the run with qpaf.m24.config.load_config + qpaf.m11.artifacts.write_json/object_hash; the run's resolved_config.json and provenance.json must reproduce these exactly.

limits.wall_time_enforcement: Enforced by the supervisor: the whole process tree is killed at wall_time_seconds and the attempt is marked FAILED with reason wall_time_exceeded.
limits.retry_rule: A fresh attempt needs a reviewed reason, a new run_id (A02) with retry_of set to the prior run_id, a new namespace and a new authorization.
limits.wall_time_basis: Same 60-minute budget as seed 1; the seed-1 QARF run took 75.4 s.

output.create_once_rule: The supervisor refuses when the namespace root already exists and creates _ATTEMPTED.json exclusively before starting the runner, so a second invocation is refused even after a failure. The runner alone would allow a retry after a failed attempt.

supervisor: <root>/_SUCCESS.json (with the fresh_process_reload report) or <root>/_FAILED.json (exactly one, after the run)
required_markers.note: The supervisor writes the _ATTEMPTED/_SUCCESS markers named in run_policy.md section 4.

invocation: <pin recorded outside this file at approval>
supervisor.source_note: src/qpaf/m53/supervisor.py reuses the M3.2 single-attempt helpers and the M3.4 shared-section names unchanged; both keep the hashes pinned by their approved authorizations.

exit_codes.0: run completed and passed every post-run check

supervisor.validity_rule: A run is valid evidence only if its namespace holds _ATTEMPTED.json, supervisor.log and exactly one of _SUCCESS.json/_FAILED.json written by this supervisor. The runner can be launched without the supervisor, so M3.3 must reject any run that lacks them.
supervisor.actor_rule: The --actor value must equal the actor field above; the supervisor refuses on any mismatch and when this field is still PENDING.

stop_conditions: source, config, data or hash drift from this manifest
pre-run verification of the M3.1 seal fails
split overlap, candidate-key mismatch, missing query or qrels leakage
development coverage below 0.95 or a query with no positive candidate
non-finite loss, gradient, parameter or metric; or checkpoint reload parity above 1e-7
wall time above limits.wall_time_seconds, or any resource, memory or telemetry violation
namespace already exists, or any actor, invocation, retry or approval mismatch
any M5.1/M5.2/M4.3 pin, frozen method source or seed-1 reference differs from this manifest
the fresh-process reload of best.pt or last.pt fails, differs by more than 1e-7 or yields a non-finite value
the finished run consumed rows or inputs other than the seed-1 run with the seed-2 config
pre_run_checks: scripts/seal_m31_inputs.py --verify <run_path> --expected-manifest-sha256 <manifest_sha256> exits 0 immediately before the run
seed_contract pins, the M5.2 receipt config for (20260821, QARF) and the M4.3 frozen source hashes all hold
this authorization equals the seed-1 M3.2 one in sealed_inputs, metric, runtime, hardware, limits and command except --config/--output
post_run_checks: provenance.json source.git_commit equals git_head recorded in _ATTEMPTED.json
data_manifest.json shows the test split as not_opened and summary.json reload_parity.passed is true
the namespace holds only _ATTEMPTED.json, supervisor.log, the QARF stage and the final marker
provenance.json inputs equal the seed-1 inputs with config replaced by config.file_sha256
summary.json names QARF, query and seed 20260821
scripts/reload_m53_checkpoint.py in a separate process reloads best.pt and last.pt, finds every value finite and reproduces validation scores, weights and metrics within 1e-7

boundaries.next_step: Hand the run to Thanh for an independent seed-2 QARF review (as M3.3 did for seed 1). The matched QPAF run needs that review recorded as ACCEPTANCE_RECORDED/PASS and its own authorization (evidence/revisions/m5.3-002).

open_items: The M5.2 cache receipt is TECHNICAL_PASS but its owner/reviewer acceptance is still PENDING_USER_REVIEW; approving this run accepts the receipt as the M5.1 R2 prerequisite.
The seed config keeps the frozen comment "frozen one-seed development gate seed" on the seed line so that only the seed digits differ from the frozen bytes.
summary.json will repeat experiment_id QPAF-M2_7-MTH-001 from the frozen config, as in M3.2/M3.4.
Commit the supervisor, its tests and this file, then re-check supervisor.source_files_sha256 against the committed blobs before filling the approval block.
